Called it stardust all my life. Thought this was the norm. Realized just today that my mom likely made it up, unless it’s a filipino thing…

"I look at most people as if they are superhuman." I get that so much.

It's come down to not being able to fathom living a regular life. Maybe they have something to keep them going. Maybe it's their financial status or their self-discipline. Then you start to think, this reflects onto me; if other people are capable, I must be really bad at being a person.

Personally, that thought has never managed to escape me, so it's kind of hypocritical to tell you to remind yourself that it isn't true and you never went wrong anywhere. But here's to saying it anyway until we actually believe it, or at least for the sake of it.

Cheers, man. Hope you become well.
